audience: creators and small businesses that sell courses, digital products or events on Ablefy (elopage)

useCases.title: Check the account and list the products
useCases.text: Check that the API key and secret work and see the connected account. Then list the products and open one by its id to read its details.

useCases.title: Find invoices that are still unpaid
useCases.text: List invoices and credit notes for a date range, and filter them by invoice or payment state. Open an order by its id to read its details.

useCases.title: Look up a payment, order or transfer
useCases.text: Look up one payment, order or transfer by its id. Read the state of a payment there. The payment lookup cannot issue a refund.

useCases.title: Review funnels and pricing plans
useCases.text: List the sales funnels and open one by its id to read its details. List the pricing plans of the account in the same review.

useCases.title: Check event tickets and webhook endpoints
useCases.text: List the e-tickets of one event, optionally only those updated since a date. List the webhook endpoints set up on the account.
